instruction: I would like to set Chrome to allocate 1GB of RAM per tab as a hard limit. This would prevent individual tabs from consuming too much memory and slowing down my entire system when I have many tabs open.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not provide any setting to configure per-tab memory limits. Chrome's memory management is handled automatically by the browser's internal resource allocator and cannot be manually configured by users.
